title: Recursive Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time reasoning methods such as iterative refinement, decomposition, and repeated sampling are often evaluated in isolation, making their gains difficult to compare across models, benchmarks, and evaluation pipelines. We introduce a unified view of these methods as recursion operators over an agent's reasoning trace: GROW, which deepens a single reasoning path; PRUNE, which decomposes and recomposes the problem; and BRANCH, which samples alternative reasoning paths and selects among them. We evaluate all three operators against a single-pass chain-of-thought baseline under a shared harness with identical prompts, token budgets, and grading code. Across five benchmarks and three frontier models, comprising 14 model-benchmark settings, 49,327 graded items, and 151,876 model calls, BRANCH improves accuracy in all 14 settings by an average of 5.98 percentage points and is the best-performing operator in 12. translated_abstract: 测试时推理方法，如迭代细化、分解和重复采样，通常被孤立评估，使得它们的增益难以跨模型、基准和评估管道进行比较。我们引入了一种统一视角，将这些方法视为智能体推理轨迹上的递归算子：GROW，加深单个推理路径；PRUNE，分解并重组问题；以及BRANCH，采样替代推理路径并从中选择。我们在一个共享测试框架下，使用相同的提示、令牌预算和评分代码，对所有三个算子与单次链式思维基线进行了评估。在五个基准和三个前沿模型上，涵盖14个模型-基准设置、49,327个评分项目和151,876次模型调用，BRANCH在所有14个设置中平均提高了5.98个百分点，并在12个设置中成为表现最佳的算子。相比之下，GROW仅产生平均...
tldr: 本文提出将测试时推理方法统一为递归算子（GROW、PRUNE、BRANCH），并通过大规模实验证明BRANCH在多个基准和模型中显著优于单次链式思维基线。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies test-time reasoning methods as recursive operators (GROW, PRUNE, BRANCH) and demonstrates through large-scale experiments that BRANCH significantly outperforms the single-pass chain-of-thought baseline across multiple benchmarks and models.
